name: WeVisDoc 2B / 4B

lineage.how_derived: fine-tuned into an end-to-end page parser (Markdown, LaTeX formulas, HTML tables)

purpose: End-to-end document parser for page images: a page becomes structured Markdown with LaTeX formulas and HTML tables (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo, text not read.

architecture.kind: dense vision-language transformer (Qwen3-VL); 4B text part: 36 layers, hidden 2560, GQA 32/8

variants.notes: Q8_0 4.69 GB, mmproj F16 0.84 GB; same files in mradermacher repos (plus imatrix)

pc-12gb.variant: GGUF Q8_0 4B plus mmproj F16 (4.69 + 0.84 GB)
pc-12gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (9.6 GB)

pc-16gb.notes: fits in the VRAM budget (13.6 GB)

engine_support.notes: Qwen3-VL architecture, so llama.cpp GGUF with mmproj works (community conversions).

benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench v1.6 Overall
benchmarks.variant: WeVisDoc-4B, mean of 3 runs (TextEdit 0.036, FormulaCDM 96.81, TableTEDS 92.95)

strengths: highest OmniDocBench v1.6 among Apache-class end-to-end parsers in its own table (ahead of HunyuanOCR-1.5 94.74, Unlimited-OCR 93.92, dots.mocr 92.57)
the 2B is within 0.3 points of the 4B
weaknesses: vendor-only evidence; comparison table includes models marked * as re-run by the vendor
English and Chinese only on the card

tona_fit.reason: Top vendor score on OmniDocBench v1.6 at 2B and 4B, Apache-2.0 tag, standard Qwen3-VL architecture; fits every class. German is the open point and needs an own check (Chandra-class models have German numbers).

open_questions: builder's reasons beyond the card text (paper arXiv 2609.20423 not opened)
